name: dither-field
title: Dither Field
description: Animated ordered-dither noise field for hero backgrounds, with a pointer lens.

props.description: Fills its positioned parent. Paints in currentColor.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Cell size in CSS px, 2 to 32. Capped at 256 columns.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Mouse over the parent swells a lens.

props.name: animated
props.description: Ambient bloom. False paints one frame.

accessibility: Listens for the pointer on its parent, so content above it stays clickable.
